items.headline: Israel's President Taps Opposition Leader Gadi Eisenkot to Form New Government
items.summary: Israel's president has asked former military chief and opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a new government after recent elections left Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu without a clear majority. This decision marks a major political setback for Netanyahu and opens the door to a potential shift in the nation's leadership.

items.headline: OpenAI Secures $11 Billion in New Funding at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
items.summary: Artificial intelligence startup OpenAI has secured an initial $11 billion in fresh funding as part of a major investment round. The deal values the company at approximately $1.25 trillion, demonstrating huge investor interest in frontier AI development despite broader market volatility.

items.headline: Arsenal Extends Premier League Lead as Manchester City Suffers Third Straight Loss
items.summary: Arsenal expanded their lead at the top of the Premier League to six points with a 1-0 victory over Hull City on Saturday. The result came as title rivals Manchester City suffered a surprise 3-1 defeat to Nottingham Forest, marking their third consecutive league loss.

items.headline: Godzilla Minus Zero Sets Record with $32 Million Box Office Debut
items.summary: Godzilla Minus Zero took the top spot at the box office this weekend with a projected $32 million debut in North America. The film set the record for the biggest North American opening weekend ever for a live-action foreign-language movie.
